name: Rhinoceros 3D
summary: NURBS modeller from McNeel & Associates. Industry standard for free-form geometry in architecture and product design.

name: Grasshopper
summary: Visual algorithmic editor inside Rhino. The de-facto language of computational design; ~500 first-party + 1,000+ third-party components.

name: Autodesk Revit
summary: BIM authoring tool. Family-based parametric modelling with shared documentation, schedules, and live drawing generation.

name: Dynamo
summary: Visual programming for Revit and other Autodesk products. Python and DesignScript dual scripting.

name: Ladybug Tools
summary: Open-source environmental analysis suite (Ladybug, Honeybee, Butterfly, Dragonfly) connecting Grasshopper to Radiance, EnergyPlus, OpenFOAM.

name: Karamba3D
summary: Parametric structural FEA inside Grasshopper. Linear elastic, geometric non-linear, eigenvalue analyses for early-stage structural design.

name: Kangaroo Physics
summary: Live physics solver for form-finding inside Grasshopper. Spring networks, hanging chains, soap films, dynamic relaxation.

name: EnergyPlus
summary: DOE whole-building energy simulation engine. Sub-hourly thermal, HVAC, and daylight simulation. Open source.

name: Radiance
summary: LBNL backwards ray-tracing renderer for accurate daylight and electric-light simulation. The reference engine for sDA, ASE, glare studies.

name: IFC schema
summary: Industry Foundation Classes — the open BIM data schema. Maintained by buildingSMART; ISO 16739.

name: Speckle
summary: Open data platform for AEC. Send geometry and metadata between Rhino, Revit, Grasshopper, Dynamo, Blender, the web. Cloud or self-hosted.

name: Open CASCADE
summary: Open-source 3D CAD/CAM/CAE kernel. BRep, NURBS, STEP/IGES I/O. Powers FreeCAD and many bespoke geometry tools.
